last_completed_unit.target: Cargo source replacement of crates.io with a local directory source
last_completed_unit.action: Inspected exactly the official Cargo Book Source Replacement page for crates.io-to-directory-source semantics and vendoring properties.
last_completed_unit.result: Cargo documents that a local directory source can replace crates.io via [source.crates-io] replace-with, and that vendored directory sources may be checked into source control. Thus a pre-populated exact vendor tree can eliminate runtime package-registry acquisition at Cargo source-selection scope. Initial vendor population/provenance, complete lockfile coverage, actual offline execution, compilation, runtime behavior, and end-to-end parity remain untested.
